entries.title: LUMEN
entries.subtitle: An illustrated adventure comic for kids, by MAVERICKS
entries.summary: Far beyond the mountains and clouds lies Lumen, a city where the most incredible ideas become real inventions. When a shadow begins to absorb its light, Leo, his friend and their robot Bin build a flying machine and set out to find the three Dawn Crystals that can restore the Heart of Lumen. A 36-page comic to read online or download, in English, Kazakh and Russian.
